Fios & Frontier vs Optimum: plant overlap at street scale

Every ~0.7 km² hex of the 23-county New York metro (incl. New Jersey, Westchester and Fairfield County, CT), colored by whose plant passes it. Verizon side splits Fios, Verizon 5G FWA and Frontier fiber — Frontier shown separately for its historical lineage. Optimum splits its cable vs fiber overlay. Overlap crosses the two. Map colors are hex presence; stat cards, trend and legend counts are location-exact.

scroll to zoom · drag to pan

Click a category to isolate it. A hex takes a class if that exact plant combination is present anywhere inside it; legend counts are location-exact for the same class definitions, so hex coloring can look broader than the counts imply.

Verizon = provider 131425 (fiber t50 = Fios; licensed FWA t71). Frontier fiber = 130258 t50, shown as part of the Verizon-side view for historical lineage but labeled Frontier throughout. Optimum = 130370 (cable t40, fiber t50). Residential-serviceable filings (R/X); availability ≠ subscribers; FWA is modeled and capacity-constrained. Geography = NY–Newark–Jersey City CBSA (22 counties) + Fairfield County CT. Source: FCC BDC fixed availability, 8 semiannual vintages.
